a.text: We're holding a feast to celebrate the end of the war! Everyone in the city is invited!

steps.name: Happy Voice
steps.text: The war's finally over! We lived through it!

steps.name: Cheering Voice
steps.text: Hahahaha, now we get to eat every day! Bread, steak, and clean new clothes on the daily!

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Whoa there, keep waving your arms like that and my stew's going to the floor—

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Careful! Let me help you.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Oh dear, girlie. Where did you come from? Didn't see you in here till now.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Though, you did save my stew. Thank you.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Maybe because I was behind you the whole time? But take your time, okay? I'll help you serve it.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Alright. Thank you, dearie.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: My pleasure. I know you've been buying medicine for the Infected and have even come to help cook today, so this is the least I could do.
The old woman smiles, and reaches out to tuck stray strands of hair back under her headband.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Ooh, that hairband of yours is so pretty.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Really? I'm glad you think so—I made it myself.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (Phew, did I subconsciously go all stealth-mode earlier? Good thing I didn't give her a fright.)

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (Now I should hurry and distribute the stew.)

steps.name: Happy Office Worker
steps.text: Oho! Look! Another dish for our table!

steps.name: Cheering Infected Worker
steps.text: Come on now, lass, you've worked enough. Sit down and eat with us!

steps.name: Joyful Rich Man
steps.text: Hear, hear! We even have red wine!

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Sure thing.

steps.name: Happy Office Worker
steps.text: Brother, I'd like to make a toast to you! Gotta thank you for helping me decorate the shop a few days back. Would've taken days more doing it alone.

steps.name: Cheering Infected Worker
steps.text: Hah! That was nothing. Didn't your family share all those fruits with mine back then? They filled my belly with hope for a better future. Just think of it as returning the favor.

steps.name: Cheering Infected Worker
steps.text: And you, I have to thank you too, for helping us rent a car! Couldn't have even gotten our hands on those fruits and veg without that!

steps.name: Joyful Rich Man
steps.text: No, no, I hardly did a thing.

steps.name: Happy Office Worker
steps.text: Haha, after going through those nightmarish days together, we'll be buddies forever! C'mon, everyone! Cheers!

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (...My hard work wasn't in vain. That's great.)

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Cheers—!

steps.name: Happy Office Worker
steps.text: Huh? What's with the long face, gramps? Food not to your taste?

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: ...No, the food is wonderful.

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: Maybe I'm just a little tired... haha.

steps.name: Happy Office Worker
steps.text: No worries. Come on, let's have a drink together! A pint of our newest brew!

steps.name: Cheering Infected Worker
steps.text: Best beer of my life!

steps.name: Joyful Rich Man
steps.text: My, my, boys! I know this is a celebration, but keep it down and try not to bother the neighbors, will you?

steps.name: Joyful Rich Man
steps.text: We should be more elegant, more 'Victorian' in our revelry! Here, a toast, with a precious vintage from my collection. Hahaha, it was worth it hiding it in the cellar!

steps.name: Cheering Infected Worker
steps.text: Sounds great!

steps.name: Cheering Infected Worker
steps.text: Let's have a toast then. I've never tried wine before!
The old man remains silent for a long time.
Before the smiles on their faces can be replaced with doubt, the old man finally clinks his glass against the rest. He drinks the wine in one gulp, then immediately stands up.

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: Alright, I'm going.
But the joyful party-goers are reluctant to let him leave just like that.

steps.name: Happy Office Worker
steps.text: Come on, we've still got more food on the way, and you're leaving already?

steps.name: Joyful Rich Man
steps.text: Just stay a while longer, old chap. Who else will enjoy this fine vintage after you're gone?

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: ...I'm good.

steps.name: Cheering Infected Worker
steps.text: Hey, just a little longer won't hurt, right?

steps.name: Happy Office Worker
steps.text: Yeah, look...

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Hey now, what if he's busy or something? No need to hold him up.

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: ...Thanks.

steps.name: Happy Office Worker
steps.text: Oh right, gramps. Where's that darling daughter of yours? Didn't bring her today?
Glass shatters as if a bomb was dropped, halting multiple conversations.
The boisterous banquet falls into a dead silence, and several people stare with shock at the broken shards on the floor.

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: My daughter is dead!

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: My little girl, who I looked after ever since she was born. Always a healthy one, and I never let her suffer even during the war. But, but...

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: But she died of acute Oripathy!

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: She had a wonderful life ahead of her! But now she's gone, while the Infected are allowed to sit here and eat with us?! Hah! Do you even care if you spread it to someone else?!

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: You, all of you, the Infected and those who allow them to live alongside you. I hate you all.

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: You'll all meet a wretched end, sooner or later.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: ...And that concludes my report on the party last night, Captain.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: These past few days, we've been resettling the Infected, helping to rebuild damaged buildings, transporting supplies, and re-opening factories and shops.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Many Infected have volunteered and contributed to our efforts. Last night was a long-awaited party to celebrate the recent work done in Caladon.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: ...I just didn't expect that. Now I'm worried that anti-Infected sentiment will return unless we do something.

spans.text: . Now I'm worried that anti-Infected sentiment will return unless we do something.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Based on our recent findings, many feel their quality of life hasn't increased since the war, but that the risk of contracting Oripathy has increased due to the growing number of the Infected.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Others have lost their family or friends to Oripathy, so the situation is... as expected, really.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: I think we need to assign people to deal with this, Captain, or it might spiral out of control.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: But we're already short on hands. Resettling injured Infected, post-war reconstruction work... There's still a lot to handle on our end too.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: The best we can manage is to keep an ear to the ground. If you notice any conflict, contact the police right away, and give them your cooperation.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: ...Understood, Captain.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: My next missions are... to visit privately opened classrooms, resettle the Infected, and organize files in Parliament...

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: I'll do my best.

steps.name: Lively Student
steps.text: (Schools have yet to reopen, and these ad-hoc classes have been going unreported to the government. But since they're run by actual school teachers, I guess it's fine.)

steps.name: Lively Student
steps.text: (Phew. The lesson's finally over. I'll head back and mark the mission as complete.)

steps.name: Whispers From The Crowd
steps.text: ...Hey, did you see it? The boy in front looks like an Infected.

steps.name: Lively Student
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Lively Student
steps.text: (I should follow them and see what's going on.)

steps.name: Whispers From The Crowd
steps.text: Whoa, he sure does! Don't sit on any chairs he's been on, or you might catch it.

steps.name: Whispers From The Crowd
steps.text: Man, the war's over, but with so many more Infected around all of a sudden, who's to say we won't catch it ourselves one day? Why don't the teachers separate us into different classes?

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Your recovery's going well and your condition's stable. Look, we even found a place for you to reopen your business. You can start from selling some daily necessities here.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: It's a good spot with plenty of foot traffic, so you won't go home empty handed. But remember to save your earnings. Don't worry about the medical bills, you can pay them when you've got extra money.

steps.name: Infected Peddler
steps.text: Alright. Thank you, really, I mean it!

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Don't mention it.

steps.name: Frantic Voice
steps.text: This a shop? Can I get two bottles of water?

steps.name: Infected Peddler
steps.text: Coming right up, sir! Here you go!

steps.name: Unhappy Voice
steps.text: —Wait! Y-Y-Your hands! Crystals?!

steps.name: Unhappy Voice
steps.text: S-S-Stay the bloody hell away from me! I don't want these! And keep the cash! I didn't survive that entire war just to catch your sickness! ...What rotten luck.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Calm down, sir. Haven't you seen the government announcements? Oripathy doesn't spread through ordinary physical contact.

steps.name: Unhappy Voice
steps.text: Hmph. Who cares what they say? I don't believe a word of it. Are they gonna help me if I get Infected later? Now go! Get far, far away from me!

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: One more, just one more...

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: And, and also...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: (Is that the old lady from the other day?)

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: What are you doing tearing down this wall by yourself, ma'am?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Ma'am?

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Haven't seen you around before, but this uniform... Are you from the government?

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: Yes, I work at the town archives. Here's my work pass.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Let me see... Looks like it's no lie! You people have been doing good work lately, so I'll talk.
The old woman stands up and points to a house surrounded by the wall.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Old Hamm's in there. A good man, and neighbor of mine for decades. We've always gotten along.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Don't know where those hooligans heard rumors about him being Infected, but they kept going on and on about how he'd infect us or whatnot, and that we should wall him in.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: He didn't want to be a bother, though, so he just agreed. But I don't. He's been sick for so long, you know, and we used to have our meals together, and I haven't caught Oripathy from him, no.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Alright, that's enough from me. When my son gets back he'll probably try and stop me, saying we'll be shunned by our neighbors if I keep this up... My goodness...

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: I'll help you out.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Oh girlie... thank you so much. My eyes aren't so good anymore, but what's your name? I'll thank you at your workplace someday.

steps.name: Kite the Recorder
steps.text: It's fine, you don't have to know who I am. I'm just someone who wants to help.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: ...That'll do. Alright, let's hurry and get this over with so Old Hamm can get some sunlight again!

steps.name: Unhappy Son
steps.text: Mum!

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Gah, speak of the Feline...

steps.name: Unhappy Son
steps.text: Didn't we talk about this, Mum? Stop knocking at that wall already! Old Hamm's not even bothered by it, so why are you?

steps.name: Unhappy Son
steps.text: What if they come after our family instead? You're too old to be causing a ruckus like this. Come on, let's go home!

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Unhappy Son
steps.text: And you. Why were you helping this stubborn old woman instead of stopping her?

steps.name: Unhappy Son
steps.text: Just go already!
Kazemaru sighs and puts down the brick in her hand as she watches the man escort his mother home.
The wall still stands, as if no matter how hard she or the old woman tried, it would remain standing for all time.
She suddenly feels her shoulders ache.
She has not felt this in ages; not even the brutal physical training from her days as a ninja left her this exhausted.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: We've done so much...

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: So why does it feel like we haven't done a thing?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Kazemaru, stop whatever you're doing and return to the office, pronto.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: A large crowd of worked up people are outside our doors demanding we hand over our Infected patients!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: One particularly angry one keeps saying his daughter died from acute Oripathy!

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: Get all those Infected out here!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Don't be rash now. I doubt anyone here was responsible for your daughter's death. They're just ordinary patients we've verified the identities of...

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: Aren't those 'ordinary patients' Infected? Won't they pass it on to others?

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: How many people have they spread their illness to and killed? Why do they get to live in peace, without taking any responsibility?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: We're a pharmaceutical company, sir. I'm in charge here, and I can assure you none of their conditions are contagious—

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: No! You're not pulling the wool over my eyes! Can you take responsibility for my daughter's death?!

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: Can you?! Huh?!

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: Exactly!

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: The war's over, and everyone's suffering. No one gives a crap about us common folk, yet there's a entire company giving special treatment to the Infected?!

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: Free treatment, free jobs! But what about the rest of us? Are you saying it's fine if we get Infected too?!

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Every Infected ought to leave Caladon!
The rowdy residents shout and yell, but no one makes a move, merely egging each other on.

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: (Whispering) Kazemaru, keep your face down, and do your best to... try and disperse the crowd.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: ...Understood.

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Hey! Who's he talking to?

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: What're you trying to pull, huh? Calling the reporters? The coppers?

steps.name: Silent Old Man
steps.text: We just want these sick people to leave and prevent any more of us from getting Infected. What's wrong with that?

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Everyone, please calm down. Like the government has been announcing, most Infected are unable to casually spread their Oripathy to others...

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: We don't have to go back to how it was a few years ago...

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: (Loudly) Yeah, no one cares about us normal folks anyways! Just yesterday I was next to an Infected, and I said 'If you're sick, then you shouldn't be mingling in public!'

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: (Loudly) Why is that so hard to understand?! Who knows if he could infect me, right? And then you know what? He launched a fireball at me before I could get another word in!

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: The Infected may occasionally lose control of their Originium Arts, but they don't do it on purpose...

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: (Loudly) He missed, but it freaked me out! What's worse, none of those sickos even bothered to see if I was hurt! Instead they went and asked if that Infected was alright!

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: (Loudly) I just wanted him to stay away from me, and he tried to attack me?! Did I deserve that, huh?!

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Ugh...
Kazemaru tries to come up with the words, but fails, not knowing how to even react.
It seems this group will refuse to hear her out no matter what she tries.
Infiltration, tracking, and baiting enemies come as naturally to her as breathing, but now she merely stands rooted to the spot, frozen amongst the crowd—
While the crowd still watches and waits, biding their next chance to tear into her, to vent their suppressed emotions.
*thump*! *thump*! *thump* *thump* *thump* *thump* ...!
A sound suddenly emerges from the crowd.
An ignorant child, blissfully unaware of what the adults were doing, was merely playing with a ball when it slipped out of his hand and rolled onto the path.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Ah, my ball!

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: 'Scuse me, 'scuse me! My ball rolled over there!
The child yells as he dives into the crowd.
The noisy crowd falls silent for a moment.
Kazemaru suddenly grows nervous.

steps.name: Skeptical Voice
steps.text: ...Hey, did you see under his sleeves? Aren't those black bits Originium crystals?

steps.name: Speculating Voice
steps.text: Looks like it. I've seen that kid before. His mum brought him along for a medicine run, which they got in a black bag. That's how Infected medicine usually gets packed.

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: 'Scuse me, 'scuse me! I saw my ball roll over here!

steps.name: Skeptical Voice
steps.text: ...Where's his parents? Why aren't they here for him?

steps.name: Unhappy Voice
steps.text: Hmph, who knows? Maybe they're Infected too, and are too afraid to come!

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: Gah, where's my ball?

steps.name: Boy
steps.text: I lost it? But how?

steps.name: Excited Voice
steps.text: Ah, he's rolling up his sleeves!

steps.name: Excited Voice
steps.text: Look! He's an Infected!

steps.name: Excited Voice
steps.text: Grab him!

steps.name: Excited Voice
steps.text: Get out of Caladon, Infected!

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (Go, my paper dolls!)

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: Wha?!

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: Where'd you come from? Are you blind?!
He clearly remembers reaching out to grab the Infected child. But now, he suddenly bumps into a stranger, and accidentally tears something off their arm.
He looks up to see the strange arm missing a chunk, but looks back down to see it in his grasp—

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: Paper?

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: That guy earlier... was made of paper?!

steps.name: Skeptical Resident
steps.text: Paper?

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: What's going on?! Let me see!

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Hey! Where did you come from? And what's that on you?

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: Say something!

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (Oh no. There are too many people, I don't have time—)

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: What's going on? Does no one watch where they're going these days?

steps.name: Angry Resident
steps.text: ...That was weird.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (Who is that? They're too far to make out...)

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (They're so fast I lost them...)

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (I should let the Captain know.)

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: No, gah, no, ma'am, let me go! I'm in the middle of something!

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: ...Huh?

steps.name: Long-winded Voice
steps.text: Gosh, you kids are hopeless. It's already past bedtime for us old folks, and you're still making so much noise on the street? No, this is not how you treat the seniors...

steps.name: Long-winded Voice
steps.text: I was hoping to get a good night's rest before making lunch for the kids tomorrow, but you rascals woke me up. And kept going on and on, till I had to come out here myself...

steps.name: Unhappy Resident
steps.text: No, we're doing this so you can live in peace!

steps.name: Long-winded Voice
steps.text: What—? My ears aren't so good anymore, you know. Talk slower, and walk slower too... You don't want me to fall, do you...?

steps.name: Long-winded Voice
steps.text: And 'live in peace', you said? How can I live in peace with all your bickering?

steps.name: No Longer Unhappy Resident
steps.text: Ah, hey! Don't whack me with your cane! Y-You...

steps.name: Long-winded Voice
steps.text: And you! I know who you are. I saw your old man looking for you earlier. You might be in for a beating if you stay out any longer!

steps.name: No Longer Angry Resident
steps.text: What?

steps.name: No Longer Angry Resident
steps.text: Ugh, I...

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (Huh? What's going on?)

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Captain? I was right about to contact you!

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: Some of the loudmouths suddenly went real quiet, and some even went home.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Seems like some people are interfering, but they don't look like officers. More like the local residents...?

steps.name: Bitter Root
steps.text: ...It's a bit strange, but I hope the crowd scatters. Let's keep watch for a while. Stay in touch if anything else happens.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Roger.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (Weird...)

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Careful, ma'am. Anything I can help you with?
The elderly woman does not answer, only nodding just slightly to Kazemaru as she goes, walking into the halfway melting crowd.
Kazemaru turns around to see the old woman lean the crutch she was using on a street corner. On closer inspection, she realizes it is just a mop handle.
The woman's figure disappears into the crowd.
Kazemaru did not get to see her face clearly, but just barely notices a beautiful headband resting among the old lady's white hair.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: That was...

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Maybe because I was behind you the whole time? But take your time, okay? I'll help you serve it.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Alright. Thank you, dearie.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: My pleasure. I know you've been buying medicine for the Infected and have even come to help cook today, so this is the least I could do.
The old woman smiles, and reaches out to tuck stray strands of hair back under her headband.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Ooh, that hairband of yours is so pretty.

steps.name: Busy Old Woman
steps.text: Really? I'm glad you think so—I made it myself.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (That hairband...)

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: (Was that the old woman I helped out before?)
Kazemaru pats her outfit. In the past few days, she has been constantly swapping from one role to another—sometimes she's a naive student, sometimes a government worker, and sometimes just a local.
Perhaps that is the reason she went unrecognized. Perhaps the old woman merely wanted to express her gratitude to a stranger.
Kazemaru notices some new, unfamiliar faces in the crowd, and has no clue who they are.
But even so, she recognizes the kindness and effort from these strangers too, and feels a little invigorated.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: Time to head back to the office to sort some files and make a report.
A few days later

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: 'This report summarizes the recent situation in Caladon. We witnessed a relatively threatening anti-Infected rally.'

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: 'But with help from the police and several anonymous residents, the unrest was quickly quelled.'

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: 'The city council has also received the new Infected bill and is redesigning the city quarters to ensure the Infected and non-Infected will be able to live in peace together.'
Her report complete, Kazemaru pauses for a thought.

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: 'Though we have encountered many difficulties, there are many more besides us who are also doing their best to prevent the situation from worsening.'

steps.name: Kazemaru
steps.text: 'Some frustration is inevitable, but as long as we persevere, the situation will definitely improve.'
Kazemaru puts down her pen, folds the report, and slots it into an envelope. She then quickly changes into her recorder outfit and walks out the door.
She feels as if she is experiencing the long-lost feeling of being a ninja.
In fact, she is no longer operating solo. Around her are many other 'ninjas', with hidden names and identities, who have been working in silence to turn things for the better.
She looks toward the government building not too far away. Caladon's city council is about to hold a special meeting soon.
'However, we will need a little more time to handle this.'
